summary: After a large housing vote, an older neighbor asks for a park instead and the developer talks about decades ahead.
realLife: After a council approved a large housing project over the testimony of dozens of speakers, a resident of many decades said she would rather have a park or garden on the site. The developer answered with a hope that the neighborhood would value the project years on. Opponents said they would stay involved. They feared traffic, air and health risks on a former dump and had a short window to sue.
sources: CBS Sacramento (Sacramento, California), 'East Sacramento residents vowing to stop McKinley Park Village after council vote', April 30, 2014: https://cbsnews.com/sacramento/news/east-sacramento-residents-vowing-to-stop-mckinley-park-village-after-council-vote/
